senses.gloss: sostika (nt., = Skt. svastika, cf. Pkt. satthia; in other mgs., Pali sotthika; 〔§ 3.117〕), the cross-legged posture in sitting: niṣaṇṇa ˚kena LV 〔241.12〕 (vs). Despite variants in mss., this is the only true reading, and is supported by Tib. (skyil mo kruṅ), contrary to Foucauxʼs statement (〔Notes p. 156〕; there is in Tib.ʼs rendering of this line no equivalent of narendraḥ, which is read in Calc. and some mss.).
